title: Sausage Runner
description: Dash through a hilarious kitchen gauntlet as a bendy cartoon sausage—duck under slicing knives, leap sizzling frying pans, and reach the finish unburnt.
controls: Hold to lean/slide under kitchen hazards and release to sprint cleanly past slicers and burners.

zh-CN.title: 香肠跑酷
zh-CN.description: 爆笑魔性跑酷香肠跑酷：化身软萌大香肠在厨房案板生死狂奔，极限下腰躲菜刀、跨过热油锅冲向终点！
zh-CN.controls: 按住弯腰滑行躲避菜刀与机关，松手恢复全速冲刺逃离危险厨房。
